summary: Iteration 9 – SEO route aliases + editable Impressum/Datenschutz legal pages. ALL TESTS PASS. Backend pytest 13/13: GET /api/sitemap.xml contains /ablauf-zum-fuehrerschein, /vku-unterricht, /impressum, /datenschutz, homepage and all 11 fahrschule-* location URLs. GET /api/content has top-level 'impressum' (5 sections, title_de='Impressum', title_en='Imprint') and 'datenschutz' (6 sections, title_de='Datenschutzerklärung', title_en='Privacy policy'). PATCH /api/content with dot key 'impressum.title_de' updates globally and restores. PATCH requires auth (401/403 without token). All 7 frontend routes return 200 with React SPA shell (/, /ablauf, /ablauf-zum-fuehrerschein, /vku, /vku-unterricht, /impressum, /datenschutz, /fahrschule-einsiedeln). Frontend Playwright 9/9: /impressum renders [data-testid='impressum-page'], overline 'Rechtliches' (CSS-uppercased), H1 'Impressum', sections 0-4. /datenschutz renders [data-testid='datenschutz-page'], overline 'Datenschutz', H1 'Datenschutzerklärung', sections 0-5. Language toggle DE→EN on /impressum changes H1 to 'Imprint' and section-0 h2 to 'Responsible for the content'. Both old (/ablauf, /vku) and new (/ablauf-zum-fuehrerschein, /vku-unterricht) routes render the correct ablauf-page / vku-page. Footer links on / and /fahrschule-einsiedeln have data-testid='footer-impressum-link' (href=/impressum) and data-testid='footer-datenschutz-link' (href=/datenschutz); clicking navigates correctly. Admin inline editing: After login (saferide_admin_token in localStorage) and toggling 'Bearbeiten' on toolbar, the H1 becomes contentEditable with data-edit-path='impressum.title_de'. Editing 'Impressum'→'Impressum TEST' on blur triggered PATCH /api/content with body {"impressum.title_de":"Impressum TEST"}; reload showed 'Impressum TEST' persisted. Restored to 'Impressum' via API. '+ Abschnitt' add button increased sections 5→6 (PATCH impressum.sections sent the full new array). impressum-section-remove-5 removed it (6→5). Final DB state verified: 5 sections, title_de='Impressum'.
critical_code_review_comments: Editable.jsx only renders the data-edit-path attribute when editMode is true (line 43-45 short-circuit returns plain <Tag>). This is correct for production but means data-edit-path selectors are NOT testable from public/non-admin sessions – future testing agents must inject the saferide_admin_token into localStorage AND toggle the 'Bearbeiten' button before asserting on data-edit-path.

LegalPage.removeSection uses native window.confirm() – Playwright must pre-attach a dialog handler (page.on('dialog', d => d.accept())) before clicking impressum-section-remove-N, consistent with the same pattern flagged for LocFaq in iteration_8. Consider replacing with a Radix AlertDialog for better UX and testability.

Sitemap_xml correctly exposes the long SEO paths (/ablauf-zum-fuehrerschein, /vku-unterricht) while header navigation still uses short paths (/ablauf, /vku). Both paths render the same component because App.js routes both. Recommend adding a single canonical <link rel='canonical'> in AblaufPage/VkuPage pointing to the long SEO URL to avoid duplicate-content SEO penalty.

LegalPage.jsx (149 lines) is well-sized. Backend default_pages.py is now 583 lines – still under the 700-line threshold but approaching it; consider splitting DEFAULT_LOCATIONS into its own file if more legal/regional pages are added.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Editable.jsx returns plain <Tag>(no data-edit-path) when editMode=false. To assert inline-editing behavior, log in via API, inject localStorage.setItem('saferide_admin_token', token), then click [data-testid='toolbar-toggle-edit'] which toggles between 'Vorschau' (preview/off) and 'Bearbeiten' (edit/on). When on, contentEditable spans appear with data-edit-path attribute. The native confirm() in LegalPage.removeSection and LocFaq.removeFaq needs page.on('dialog', d => d.accept()). All 11 location slugs: einsiedeln, siebnen, lachen, waedenswil, horgen, altendorf, chur, lenzerheide, rapperswil, pfaeffikon-sz, richterswil. Legal data-testids: impressum-page, impressum-section-0..4, impressum-section-add, impressum-section-remove-N, datenschutz-page, datenschutz-section-0..5, datenschutz-section-add, datenschutz-section-remove-N, footer-impressum-link, footer-datenschutz-link.
rca of the issue: N/A – no functional bugs found. Initial Playwright failures using [data-edit-path='...'] selectors as a non-admin were a tester-side issue (Editable.jsx intentionally omits the attribute outside edit mode). Fixed by switching public-page assertions to <h1>/data-testid based selectors, and admin assertions to inject the JWT into localStorage + toggle edit mode.
